end.parentNote: Kabir practised subtraction stories and linking subtraction with addition. Using a number line was difficult because it was not visible on screen; when guided to count back from 8, they said 7, 6, 5 and reached 5. The mix-up about subtraction order was corrected later, but “how many more” was still answered by adding; at home, draw a number line to 9 and practise counting back and comparing two groups.
